messages:
alex (product): Quick sync — need to finalize streaming contract for chat completions (SSE vs WS, delta format, finish reasons). Customers are asking for resume, deterministic finish reasons, and clean SDK hooks. Can we converge?

mia (eng-runtime): TL;DR: both SSE and WS are doable, tradeoffs: SSE = easy HTTP/CDN-friendly, reconnect semantics straightforward; WS = multiplexing & lower round trips for small messages.

sam (devex): From SDK perspective we want a simple API: onDelta, onFinish, onError, onReconnect. Avoid forcing app authors to parse low-level events.

jordana (eng-ml): Delta format matters for function/tool calling & structured outputs. Prefer event payloads that include: {delta, role?, content?, function_call?:{name, args_fragment}} so we can stream partial function args. Example: 
```json
{"delta":{"content":"Hello"}}
{"delta":{"content":" world"}}
{"delta":{"function_call":{"name":"get_weather","args_fragment":"{\"city\": \""}}}
```
This lets us reassemble at client.

nate (sdk): Agree. SDK should provide reassembly helpers for function args and structured json so users don't have to write fragile parsers. Also we need clear finish reasons: `stop`, `length`, `error`, `cancelled`, `resume_needed`.

mia (eng-runtime): Important: `resume_needed` implies we provide a resume token/kvs that the client can pass back to get remaining stream. That increases state complexity on hosted. Customers asked for this, but it's heavier for Dedicated/Private.

alex (product): Launch criteria proposal: 1) server supports SSE + WS endpoints (same payloads), 2) SDKs (js/py) expose onDelta/onFinish/onError and helper to reassemble function args, 3) finish reasons standardized and documented, 4) basic reconnect with idempotent resume token (optional GA).

sam (devex): Suggest we ship with resume disabled for GA, but keep an explicit header + response fields so we can enable quickly. E.g., server returns `x-resume-token` when stream is resumable.

jordana (eng-ml): For eval & reproducibility we need deterministic finish reasons. Spec: `stop` when model emitted finish token, `length` when hit max_tokens, `cancelled` when client explicitly aborted, `error` for infra failures. `resume_needed` only when we truncated because we hit a configurable partial-result window (rare).

mia (eng-runtime): Implementation note: WS messages should be JSON objects per frame; SSE sends `event: delta\ndata: {...}\n\n`.

Example SSE: 
````
event: delta
data: {"delta":{"content":"hi"}}

````
Try to keep both surface-equivalent.

nate (sdk): Edge case: partial JSON inside delta (structured output) — clients may get invalid JSON until finish. We should strongly recommend a function-calling-style pattern where function args are streamed as string fragments and SDK exposes a `reassembled` convenience. Also adding a `final_payload` field in onFinish helps.

alex (product): Customer asks: large enterprise wants ordering guarantees and exactly-once deltas after reconnect. How realistic?

mia (eng-runtime): Exactly-once is hard over transient networks. We can provide monotonic sequence numbers per stream and server-side idempotency for resume token. That gives clients ability to dedupe and resume. Sequence numbers + resume token = good practical guarantee.

jordana (eng-ml): Also surface `partial_checksum` maybe optional to verify reassembly integrity. Might be overkill for GA.

sam (devex): Docs + examples matter. Need two canonical examples: basic text streaming, and streaming a function call with args reconstruction. 1 small snippet per SDK + one server example.

mia (eng-runtime): Performance/gating: must not increase median token latency by >5% for streaming paths, and must support 10k concurrent SSE streams on our hosted tier during canary.

alex (product): Scope negotiation: proposal to ship GA with: both endpoints, basic delta format (delta.role?, delta.content, delta.function_call fragment), finish reasons except `resume_needed`, sequence numbers, and SDK helpers for reassembly. Post-GA: full resume tokens, partial_checksum, and more complex exactly-once guarantees. Thoughts?

nate (sdk): That's reasonable. We can ship SDK v1 with helpers and feature-flag resume API. Also add `onReconnect` hook that gives sequence gap info so app can decide to fetch a fallback non-streamed response.

jordana (eng-ml): Need an eval plan: create prompt sets that exercise function-calling fragmentation, structured JSON streaming, and high-rate reconnects. Use regressions to trigger rollout gates.

alex (product): Action items: 
- @mia write runtime spec for SSE + WS payload equivalence (due EOD Fri).
- @nate draft SDK API surface and example snippets (due Tue).
- @sam draft docs + two example apps.
- @jordana create eval prompt sets and acceptance criteria.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: canary stream infra test job scheduled for this Friday 03:00 UTC :rocket:

mia (eng-runtime): I'll start the spec. Quick note: use `finish_reason` field in final event with canonical enum, and include `final_payload` for structured outputs.

alex (product): OK — thanks. We'll sync Wed 10am to lock wording. If anyone objects to the GA scope call it out here now.

sam (devex): No objections from docs side. I'll prototype examples after nate's API draft. :+1:

nate (sdk): No objections. Will add migration notes for apps that rely on pre-existing non-streamed semantics.

jordana (eng-ml): Fine from ML side. We may ask to surface a small `content_quality` metric in runtime telemetry for streaming to detect truncation artifacts.

alex (product): Perfect. Closing thread once specs land in the repo.
